A '''cave horror''' (elite) is an [[elite monster|elite version]] of the [[cave horror]]. If on a [[Slayer assignment]], an elite Cave horror is guaranteed to spawn; otherwise, elite monsters have a spawn rate of 1 in 1,000. Elite spawn rates can be further increased with the use of [[fellstalk incense stick]]s and tier 2 [[luck]]. 

Unlike its normal counterpart, the elite version has the ability to negate the effect of [[Witchwood icon]]s, allowing them to attack at a rapid rate.

==Names==
The elite versions have varying names, with a randomly generated prefix and suffix.
